components.name: Seasonal fruit
components.note: Freshly chopped seasonal fruit brings natural sweetness, crisp texture and juicy bites to contrast with the creamy ice cream.

components.name: Vanilla ice cream

taste:
This is a chilled dessert built around the contrast between juicy seasonal fruit and soft vanilla ice cream. The freshly chopped pieces bring crispness and natural sweetness, while the ice cream adds a richer, smoother mouthful. Vanilla sits alongside the fruit rather than replacing its fresh flavour, so the appeal is in moving between those different textures.

After a heavy meal, that crisp, juicy element offers a refreshing change of pace. You can take the fruit and ice cream together for a creamy bite, or eat them separately to keep the contrast distinct. It suits a warm afternoon, too, when a chilled finish sounds more appealing than another substantial course.
